categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power generation including coal-fired power, gas power, nuclear power, combined heat and power, and integrated energy. The company has expanded into photovoltaic manufacturing through its control of Suzhou Zhonglai Photovoltaic New Material Co., Ltd., focusing on photovoltaic auxiliary materials, high-efficiency cells, modules, and related applications, forming a dual main business model of thermal power generation and new energy manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ultra-supercritical coal-fired power generation technology, gas turbine technology, and nuclear power technology. In photovoltaic manufacturing, it employs high-efficiency solar cell technologies such as N-type TOPCon cells with world-leading conversion efficiencies. The company also invests in smart factory projects for high-efficiency monocrystalline solar cells and advanced photovoltaic backsheet production lines, emphasizing innovation and technology upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major power grid companies such as State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Co., Ltd., and Shanghai Yuanye New Energy Co., Ltd. The company serves the electricity and heat supply markets primarily within Zhejiang Province and other regions in China, with photovoltaic products sold domestically and internationally. The energy market includes industrial, commercial, and residential electricity and heat consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Zhejiang Province, China, with significant assets and operations in cities like Hangzhou, Ningbo, Wenzhou, Jiaxing, Shaoxing, and others. It also has investments and subsidiaries in other provinces such as Anhui, Jiangsu, Shanxi, and Xinjiang. Its photovoltaic manufacturing and related businesses have international presence through subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Italy, Luxembourg, Spain, Australia, and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and heat supply. Through its photovoltaic manufacturing subsidiary, it also participates upstream in the renewable energy equipment manufacturing supply chain, producing key components like solar backsheets and high-efficiency solar cells.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-quality energy supply security and green energy transition, focusing on innovation-driven development, reform empowerment, and dual main business growth in thermal power and new energy manufacturing. R&D priorities include advanced coal power technologies, nuclear power, photovoltaic materials, and smart manufacturing. The company invests significantly in R&D, with over 500 million RMB in expenses, and focuses on developing high-efficiency solar cells and modules.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of electricity and heat, photovoltaic products including solar backsheets, cells, and modules, and related energy services. The company also earns income from investments in joint ventures and associates, government subsidies, and other operational revenues. Sales are recognized upon delivery and transfer of control to customers, with contracts involving both point-in-time and over-time performance obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest power generation enterprise in Zhejiang Province, holding about 57.6% of the province's coal-fired power installed capacity. It is a major player in thermal power and is expanding in nuclear and renewable energy sectors. Its photovoltaic subsidiary is a global leader in solar backsheet shipments and high-efficiency solar cells. Competitors include other provincial power companies, national energy groups, and photovoltaic manufacturers domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately 95.98 billion RMB, a 19.68% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.52 billion RMB, reversing previous losses. Total assets reached about 147.24 billion RMB, up 21.76% from the prior year. The company’s net asset value increased by 10.11%. It has shown strong growth in power generation volume and photovoltaic product sales, supported by strategic acquisitions and capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power emphasizes reliable and secure energy supply as its core value, being a key energy supplier in Zhejiang with high operational efficiency and safety standards. Its dual main business model integrates traditional thermal power with cutting-edge photovoltaic manufacturing, offering diversified energy solutions. The photovoltaic subsidiary’s global leadership in solar backsheet production and advanced cell technology provides competitive differentiation. The company also highlights its strong government backing and commitment to green, low-carbon energy transition.
